data.name: Nawaal
data.gender_notes: Nawaal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nawaal is derived from the Arabic word ‘nawaah’, meaning a gentle breeze or soft wind. This name is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of a virtuous woman who lived during the time of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name is also mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Fajr. The name Nawaal carries the meaning “Gentle Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawaal usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of tranquility and peace, inspiring calmness and relaxation.
data.etymology: Nawaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawaal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
